caseNameFull: Black v. Collins, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division
judges: Application, Blackmun, Certiorari, Disposition, Grant, Pending, Stay, Stevens, Tice, Writ

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, and Jus*938tice O’Connor would grant the application for stay of execution pending the disposition of the petition for writ of certiorari.
